title: Bole Moving Guide: Atlas, Friendship City & Airport Corridor (2026)

content:
Moving in Bole sub-city

Bole is Addis Ababa’s busiest commercial and residential hub — home to the international airport corridor, Atlas and Olympia districts, Friendship City condos, and embassy-adjacent streets. Moves here are less about distance and more about access, security, and timing.

Common Bole move types

  • High-rise apartment and serviced residence relocations
  • Office and retail moves along Bole Road and Medhanialem
  • Cross-town moves from Bole to CMC, Sarbet, or Lemi Kura (Ayat)
  • Expat households coordinating with property managers and hotel front desks

Logistics tips

Book freight or service lifts early in popular compounds such as Friendship City and newer Atlas-side towers—many allow only 2–3 hour freight blocks on weekdays. Diplomatic and high-security addresses near Old Airport and UNECA lanes may require advance crew ID lists and plate numbers 48 hours ahead. Staging trucks on narrow side streets off Cameroon Street or around Edna Mall may need security coordination—factor an extra 20–40 meter carry into your survey.

Landmarks crews navigate

  • Bole International Airport corridor — height and time restrictions near approach paths on certain roads.
  • Friendship City & Olympia — dense condo stock; service lift dimensions vary by block year.
  • Medhanialem / Bole Road — office moves often after 18:00 when building management allows freight.
  • Bole Bulbula — separate access patterns; see our Bole Bulbula page if your move is south of the main Bole core.

Traffic

Bole Road and airport-adjacent routes congest mid-day and evenings. Early Saturday starts often beat weekday rush when buildings allow weekend moves.

Pricing drivers in Bole

High-rise freight, long carries from side streets, and after-hours office loads often matter more than bedroom count. Visible starting tiers for studios through villas are on our homepage pricing section; your survey adds stairs, packing level, and diplomatic gate time. Office relocations along Bole Road typically start from 45,000 ETB with inventory lists—see office relocation.

Expat and property-manager moves

Serviced residences and embassy-adjacent compounds may require vendor insurance certificates and crew passports on file. Share property manager contact details at booking so lift slots and ID lists are confirmed before deposit. For packing norms on electronics over cobblestone segments, see fragile packing guide.

Neighbor and end-of-month tips

Friendship City and Atlas towers stack move-outs at month-end. Pair with a neighbor for one elevator block when management allows—group move discounts. Written quotes prevent day-of fees—contract red flags.
